recognize_zh: 箭頭所指細胞含五個大小相近、染色質濃縮的圓形核，細胞質呈均勻灰藍色（多染性紅血球母細胞質地）且無顆粒，即為多核（五核）紅血球母細胞，是紅系發育異常（dyserythropoiesis）的線索。
features: Erythroblast (arrow) containing five separate round nuclei of similar size
Nuclei have condensed, clumped chromatin without nucleoli, consistent with polychromatophilic-stage maturation
Agranular gray-blue cytoplasm with a smooth round cell outline
Adjacent granulocytes (band and segmented forms) with preserved granulation
Background red cells and scattered platelets; a smudged pink granular cell fragment is present
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered maturing granulocytes and red cells. The arrowed cell is an erythroblast with agranular gray-blue cytoplasm containing five discrete, round nuclei with condensed chromatin, representing a multinucleated (pentanucleated) erythroid precursor. Adjacent granulocytes show preserved granulation in this field. Findings indicate dyserythropoiesis; in the clinical context, they are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome, though multinuclearity alone is not specific and must be interpreted with the proportion of dysplastic erythroid cells and cytogenetics.

ddx.dx: Congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II or III
ddx.vs: CDA shows multinucleated erythroblasts (bi-nucleated in type II, giant multinucleated in type III) in a young patient without other lineage dysplasia or clonal cytogenetics.
Megaloblastic anemia gives nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open sieve-like chromatin and giant metamyelocytes, and it corrects with B12 or folate.
Osteoclasts have many separate nuclei with abundant granular cytoplasm and megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei in far larger cells, unlike this small agranular erythroblast.
Toxic dyserythropoiesis can look identical, so exposure history and reversibility after withdrawal separate it from clonal MDS.
